title: Iza
tagline: Automate your investments with Vincent. The app applies dca
description: The Vincent DCA App automates your dca strategy using Vincent’s intelligent automation engine, the app regularly invests a set amount into your chosen assets, removing emotion and guesswork from your investment process. Designed for both new and experienced investors, it ensures consistent, disciplined growth while saving you time through seamless, fully automated execution.
how_its_made:
The Vincent DCA App is built around Vincent’s automation engine, which handles the scheduling, execution, and monitoring of investments. Here’s the basic structure

	Frontend: React (Web) 
	•	Backend: Node.js 
	•	Automation: Vincent API / Workflows
	•	Database: MongoDb
	•	Integration: Broker & exchange APIs
